name: Engineering of Soft Matter
description: Intermolecular interactions, statistical mechanical approach to thermodynamic potentials. Nucleation and spontaneous phase separations in complex fluids (liquid-liquid unmixing, crystallization); phase separation kinetics (universality, order parameter evolution, Cahn-Hillard equation, Ostwald ripening); development of effective interactions of colloidal systems and polymers, thermodynamics and rheology of colloidal systems and polymers; brief on soft-matter characterization techniques including thermal analysis, electron microscopy, and small angle X-ray and neutron scattering throughout the course. Contemporary research topics with high technological relevance, for example, external field-induced effects on assembly in complex fluids, surface instabilities: onset conditions, morphology, control and evolution.
